attack_vector: An attacker inserts or modifies documents in the retrieval corpus so poisoned embeddings cause the system to retrieve misleading, malicious, or policy-bypassing content.
prerequisites: Untrusted content can enter the corpus
No document provenance or approval workflow
Retrieved content is treated as trusted context

mitigations.description: Gate corpus ingestion with provenance and approval controls
mitigations.implementation: Require source allowlists, document signatures, ingestion review, and trust labels before content is embedded or retrieved.

indicators: Large number of new documents from untrusted source
Unexpected changes in top-k retrieval for sensitive queries

attack_vector: A retrieval query returns documents, chunks, embeddings, or metadata belonging to another tenant because namespace, ACL, or metadata filtering is missing or bypassed.
prerequisites: Tenant filters applied outside the search primitive or not enforced
Retrieved content is returned to model/user

mitigations.description: Enforce tenant isolation at retrieval time
mitigations.implementation: Use separate tenant indexes or mandatory tenant allowlists inside retrieval, with authorization checks before returning chunks.

indicators: Returned chunk tenant_id differs from requester tenant_id
Missing tenant filter in vector queries
Shared global namespace for sensitive corpora

attack_vector: A document contains hidden or explicit instructions that are retrieved as context and interpreted by the LLM as higher-priority instructions.
prerequisites: Prompt does not clearly delimit quoted source content

mitigations.description: Treat retrieved content as quoted data, not instructions
mitigations.implementation: Wrap retrieved chunks in structured fields, include source trust labels, and require the model to ignore instructions inside retrieved documents.

attack_vector: Vector index metadata, document IDs, chunk text, source paths, tenant labels, or embedding cache files expose sensitive business, code, or personal data.
prerequisites: Index files or retrieval APIs are accessible

mitigations.implementation: Store opaque IDs in the vector index and fetch authorized metadata from a protected source after retrieval.

threat_name: Vector Search Cost or Latency Exhaustion
attack_vector: Attackers issue high-volume, broad, or adversarial retrieval queries that trigger expensive embedding generation, large top-k searches, re-ranking, or index scans.
prerequisites: High top-k or expensive reranking enabled

mitigations.implementation: Limit query length, top-k, rerank candidates, embedding calls, and requests per tenant. Cache repeated embeddings and apply circuit breakers.
